professional_basis: Market-neutral statistical arbitrage: estimate each alt's BTC beta, trade only an extreme idiosyncratic negative shock, and hedge systematic BTC direction. Negative shocks are singled out because recent residual-reversal research reports faster reversal than positive shocks.

data.source: Binance public USD-M checksumed 1m and actual funding archives
data.execution: both legs at first actual 1m open after signal

signal.symbol_choice: most negative z times relative volume; deterministic universe tie-break

position.btc_leg: short beta times $60 notional, capped at $120

claim_policy: Historical data are development-only. Passing permits paper-forward only; no guarantee of profit.
